name: Rapid Augmenter
oracle_text:
Haste
Whenever another creature you control with base power 1 enters, it gains haste until end of turn.
Whenever another creature you control enters, if it wasn't cast, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature and this creature can't be blocked this turn.
blocked_sentences: Whenever another creature you control enters, if it wasn't cast, put a +1/+1 counter on this creature and this creature can't be blocked this turn.

needs.what: a trigger filter / condition on a permanent_enters trigger asking whether the ENTERING permanent (not the trigger's source) arrived by resolving as a cast spell -- the entered_by_cast flag on that object -- so "whenever another creature you control enters, if it wasn't cast" fires for tokens, reanimation, blinks, put-onto-battlefield effects and not for creatures cast from any zone
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The was_cast condition reads the ability's own source and the loader restricts it to self_enters triggers (WAS_CAST_TRIGGERS), explicitly refusing it on permanent_enters because there it would answer about this creature, not the one that entered; trigger_keys' not_cause refuses a single named cause and misses reanimation, blinks and Show and Tell; trigger_filter_keys and selector_keys have no cast/entered-by-cast key. Dropping the clause would make every cast creature grow and unblock this one.
